subject: Urgent: multi-region throughput regression — proposed contract amendment & credit schedule
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stargaze.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, procurement@stargaze.com
Cc: samir.rao@stargaze.com
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Severe throughput drop across east/us & eu regions — logs attached

Jonas —

We observed a recurring throughput regression starting 2026-07-24 03:00 UTC that impacted our batch scoring pipelines in us-east and eu-west. Token throughput dropped ~45% during peak windows, and error rates (5xx) spiked to 2.8% for about 6 hours total. This materially impacted our nightly processing and downstream dashboards.

See attached stargaze_slo_logs_20260725.csv for request-level deltas and timestamps. Procurement copied here to surface potential SLA remediation and any credit/contract remedies.

Can you confirm receipt and outline the immediate steps Redwood will take? We need an estimate of make-good credits by EOD tomorrow and a plan to ensure multi-region resilience before our next release. Our legal and finance teams will want numbers they can plug into forecasts.

Thanks —
Alyssa Chen
Head of Data Platform, Stargaze
alyssa@stargaze.com
Phone: +1-415-555-0122

Alyssa — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. We received the CSV. I'm sorry for the disruption here.

Immediate items:
- I've escalated to on-call infra and our runtime team; preliminary traces show a regression in our cross-region circuit-breaker behavior under low-pool-fanout. We have a hotfix candidate and are running canary tests now.
- Can we schedule a short exec sync tomorrow at 10:30 PT? I'll bring Naomi (SRE), Ben (Commercial), and our runtime lead. That will let us agree on credit/contract options live.
- For transparency, we'll propose two options ahead of the call: (A) one-time operational credit pegged to measured throughput shortfall; (B) contract amendment that adds a tiered credit schedule plus a low-latency routing SLA for multi-region traffic.

I've asked Ben to prepare commercial numbers and Naomi to validate impact windows. Attaching an internal calc workbook shortly.

— Jonas
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_credit_calc_v1.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Stargaze throughput shortfall — proposed numbers for exec call

Team — quick internal note ahead of tomorrow's sync. Summary of findings after initial triage:
- Affected windows: 2026-07-24 03:00 UTC through 2026-07-24 09:00 UTC and 2026-07-25 02:30 UTC through 2026-07-25 06:00 UTC.
- Aggregate throughput shortfall vs contract baseline: 42% average across impacted windows (weighted by volume).
- Error spike: 2.8% 5xx during peaks; overall user-impact hours: ~7.5 hours.

Commercial proposal (for discussion):
1) One-time make-good credit: 2.5% of trailing three-month usage spend, applied to next invoice (simple, fast).
2) Contract amendment option: Tiered credit schedule for future events (if shortfall >20% for >2 hours): 1.5% credit per incident up to 5% cap per quarter; add explicit routing SLA to prefer region-local pools for latency-sensitive flows. Also include a technical remediation milestone schedule (hotfix, canary, full rollout within 72 hours).
3) For immediate goodwill, offer an expedited dedicated-capacity review: 30% discounted trial of dedicated pool for one month (credit applied if Stargaze converts to Dedicated).

I've put draft numbers into redwood_credit_calc_v1.xlsx (tab: STARGAZE_PROPOSAL). Key assumptions are in the 'notes' column. Laura — please sanity-check legal/contract language and whether we need a side-letter or an amendment. Ben — please prepare what approvals we need for a one-time credit vs amendment. Naomi — confirm the timestamps and scope; if we adjust impacted hours that will move the credit quantum.

Thanks — Jonas
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stargaze.com>, Procurement <procurement@stargaze.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood remediation offer & proposed contract amendment (summary)

Alyssa / Samir / Procurement —

Thanks for the time on today's call. Per our discussion, here's a concise summary of Redwood's proposed remediation package for the multi-region throughput regression and next steps: 

Offer A — Expedite credit (fast):
- One-time operational credit equal to 2.5% of Stargaze's trailing 3-month Redwood hosted spend. Credit applied to the next invoice.
- Timeline: credit applied within two billing cycles after signature of the attached amendment acceptance form.

Offer B — Contract amendment (preferred for repeatability):
- Introduce a Tiered Throughput Credit Schedule: if throughput shortfall >20% for >2 hours, credit = 1.5% of trailing 3-month spend per incident; cumulative cap 5% per quarter.
- Add a Multi-region Routing SLA: Redwood commits to route 95% of region-tagged low-latency requests to local pools (subject to pinned model compatibility).
- Technical commitments: hotfix canary within 6 hours, full rollout within 72 hours for infra regressions attributable to Redwood.

Goodwill add-ons (both offers):
- Discounted 30% trial on dedicated capacity for one month (credit applied against trial fee if Stargaze converts).
- Free joint postmortem and an engineering workshop to harden cross-region routing.

Next steps:
1) Please indicate which offer you prefer (A or B) by replying to this thread.
2) If B, Procurement: we'll route a draft amendment and side-letter to your legal for review. Link to draft: https://app.redwood.com/contract/amend/DEAL-4782-STG
3) We will apply the one-time credit immediately upon a signed acceptance form; amendment will require typical legal review (~7-10 business days).

Attachments: redwood_credit_calc_v1.xlsx (proposal tab)

We aim to be responsive here — and we own the remediation. Please let us know if you'd like a follow-up call with our CTO.

— Jonas Weber
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Phone: +1-650-555-0199
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@stargaze.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@stargaze.com>, procurement@stargaze.com
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood remediation offer & proposed contract amendment (summary)

Jonas — appreciate the clear options and quick turnaround. Procurement prefers Offer B (contract amendment) to get a repeatable framework in place; legal will review the draft amendment you linked. Two points from our side: 

1) Please include explicit SLAs for incident communication (initial response within 30 minutes, hourly updates during incident) in the amendment.
2) Can you confirm the mechanism for calculating 'trailing 3-month spend' (UTC vs billing timezone) and whether credits apply to usage or to account balance? We need that in writing for our finance team.

Procurement will start review today and loop in legal. We'll aim to provide redlines within 7 business days. If you can add the two clarifications above to the draft amendment before we begin redline, that will speed review.

Thanks — Samir Rao
Head of Procurement, Stargaze
samir.rao@stargaze.com
